mapper.sql: select c.cut_order_id, c.cut_order_no, c.production_order_id, c.production_order_no, c.sales_order_id, c.sales_order_no, c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.plan_finish_time, c.finish_time, c.total_qty, ifnull(d.actual_cut_qty, 0) as actual_cut_qty, c.cut_status, case c.cut_status when 0 then '待裁剪' when 1 then '裁剪中' when 2 then '已完成' when 3 then '已取消' else '未知' end as cut_status_name, case when c.cut_status in (0, 1) and c.plan_finish_time < now() then 1 else 0 end as timeout_flag, d.item_summary, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from erp_cut_order c left join ( select cut_order_id, sum(ifnull(cut_qty, 0)) as actual_cut_qty, group_concat(concat_ws(' / ', style_no, style_name, color_name, size_name, plan_qty) order by cut_detail_id separator '; ') as item_summary from erp_cut_order_detail group by cut_order_id ) d on d.cut_order_id = c.cut_order_id
mapper.select:
and c.cut_order_no like concat('%', #{cutOrderNo}, '%') and c.production_order_no like concat('%', #{productionOrderNo}, '%') and c.sales_order_no like concat('%', #{salesOrderNo}, '%') and c.customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%') and c.cut_status = #{cutStatus}
order by timeout_flag desc, c.plan_finish_time asc, c.cut_order_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into erp_cut_order(cut_order_no, production_order_id, production_order_no, sales_order_id, sales_order_no, customer_id, customer_name, plan_finish_time, finish_time, total_qty, cut_status, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{cutOrderNo}, #{productionOrderId}, #{productionOrderNo}, #{salesOrderId}, #{salesOrderNo}, #{customerId}, #{customerName}, #{planFinishTime}, #{finishTime}, #{totalQty}, #{cutStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from erp_cut_order where cut_order_id in #{cutOrderId}
